From: Jordan Lee <jordan@greenmesh.ai>

Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick ask — expired promo & trial window

Hi Laura,

Hope you had a good holiday — quick one from the GreenMesh eval team. We were running a week-long production-like load test of the Redwood hosted API to validate latency and cost for an upcoming feature. The trial promo we were on expired mid-test (Jan 6) and our sandbox has now been locked out.

We have about 13k tokens of model output left in our evaluation bucket but need ~25k more to finish the last set of throughput tests and a short security review. Is there any chance we can get a one-time top-up of promo credits (~25k tokens) and a 30-day evaluation window added so we can complete this? We’re at the point where the last run will determine whether we go to an internal POC next quarter.

I attached the POC_Summary.pdf and a usage_snapshot.csv showing the run details and costs. If there’s any procurement or paperwork you need, I can get that started immediately.

Appreciate any help here — I can be flexible on the exact amount if you have internal limits.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of AI, GreenMesh
jordan@greenmesh.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear context and the attachments, they helped a lot.

Short answer: we can make a one-off exception here to preserve momentum. Proposed approach:

- Apply a temporary bridge of 20,000 trial tokens to your account within 24 hours.
- Add a 21-day evaluation window from the time the credits are applied.
- We’ll require a short confirmation of procurement intent (email stating GreenMesh’s PO contact and approximate spend range) and acceptance of one-page promo terms (attached).

Notes: the 20k bridge is a discretionary, one-time exception for trial-to-PO motion. If you need the full 25k we can consider topping up after the usage review, but I want to get you back online quickly. Ben — can you confirm the credit application and whether we can mark this as an outbound exception (deal RWI-4853)? Marissa — tagging you to coordinate CS check-in once the run completes.

Jordan — if that plan works, reply with the PO contact and I’ll get the credits queued and send the DocuSign link for the short promo terms.

Best,
Laura Bennett
